title: Mind Flayer Brain
summary: Eat the newborn mind flayer’s brain to add one point to the party’s Illithid Powers pool.

fields.Consume: Adds one shared Illithid Powers point if the eater previously consumed a Parasite Specimen. Any eligible party member can spend it. Feeding the newborn mind flayer first makes the brain ineffective.
fields.Acquisition: Loot the newborn mind flayer in the Windmill Basement.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
